root_cause.text: The write handler validates the user-provided offset against a 4-byte boundary (`mmio_phys_end - 4`) while the show handler performs an 8-byte read (`readq`), allowing an offset near the end of the MMIO region to cause a 4-byte out-of-bounds read.
root_cause.evidence: The patch changes `iommu->dbg_mmio_offset > iommu->mmio_phys_end - 4` to `iommu->dbg_mmio_offset > iommu->mmio_phys_end - sizeof(u64)`, and the commit description explicitly states that using an offset of `mmio_phys_end - 4` passes the check but leads to an out-of-bounds read due to the 8-byte `readq()` in `iommu_mmio_show()`.
